format: gzip, big-endian NBT compound blocks list; network_id verified against computed FNV-1a typed state hash

nativeProtocol.source: github.com/shawtymarco/go-multiversion data/v2225 (NOT an embedded copy in this directory)
nativeProtocol.note: 2225 uses HASHED wire block IDs: the dense order of block_states.nbt is NOT the network ID. loadRegistry2225() computes StateHash(name, properties) and rejects collisions; translation uses canonical indices. No network_id pin exists or is possible for this snapshot.

itemRegistries.source: 2225 (native) = go-multiversion data/v2225 vanilla_items.nbt; 1001/2169/2193 = the go-multiversion data/v* vanilla_items.nbt dragonfly snapshots, resolved at init through mapping.NewItemMapper(native, target).TargetEntries(). These are not independent pinned copies: they are the same snapshots the protocol adapters use.

entries.reason: protocols/v1_26_44.NewWithRegistries delegates to v1_26_45.NewWithRegistries (shared 1.26.40-1.26.45 registry baseline); no data/v2168 package exists

itemRegistries.verification: TestNative2225RegistryPinsData pins the native 2225 palette (23960 states, hashed, air=18894) and item counts for all five protocols. TestItemRegistryMatchesCodec feeds the native 2225 table into each registry-aware codec and asserts the emitted name/ID mapping equals Items(id). TestClientItemRegistryWiring asserts the caller's native-vs-own-table rule, including that a non-native input is dropped by the 1001 codec. cmd/itemaudit measures the 4 items added in 2225 (disc_press, ice_crystal, icicle, frostbite_spawn_egg) that every older target lacks.

protocol2169: Shares2168 block schema; test verifies full typed StateKey set equals pinned go-multiversion/data/v2169. Does not use2168 wire codec for2169.
compatibility: Matches protocol families, not a promise for arbitrary previews or future builds sharing an ID. Custom runtime-ID ordering is rejected; custom state hashing only supports explicit typed state properties.
